note: The Codecov bash uploader shape of the 2021 compromise: the Test job pipes https://codecov.io/bash straight into bash in the same step that holds CODECOV_TOKEN and the Docker credentials, and the job also holds the remote-host and AKS secrets. Whoever controls that URL runs code next to every secret of the job. Installation needs Test for ordering alone: a bare needs hands nothing over (no artifact, cache or output read), so it is no hop of the path, and its own ISSUE-307 and ISSUE-801 count as individual findings. The runner a job runs on is not read, so it adds nothing to the reach. The path is secrets alone: High, proven. Hand count: one High path 15, two other findings (ISSUE-307 Low 2, ISSUE-801 Medium 5), so 100 - 22 = 78: B.
